title: Dandelion Seed Vortex Formation
quick_description: This is a dandelion seed falling through still air, simulated frame by frame. The faint ring forming above it is a separated vortex ring, a structure that keeps the seed aloft far longer than its size and weight should allow, and that nature seems to have stumbled onto long before fluid dynamicists had a name for it.

title: Surface Heating Effects on a Compressible Wall Jet, Imaged with Rainbow Schlieren
quick_description: My final year thesis: designing and building a Rainbow Schlieren Deflectometry (RSD) facility from scratch to quantitatively image density-gradient fields around a heated, compressible wall jet over a temperature-controlled flat plate, benchmarked against 2D CFD and a natural-convection validation case, with pyrsd, a Python library I wrote to turn the raw color images into density fields.
institution: IOE Pulchowk Campus, Final Year Project, supervised by Asst. Prof. Kamal Darlami, former Deputy HOD, and Asst. Prof. Laxman Motra, Deputy HOD, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering with team members Amogh Adhikari, Anup Bajgain, and Yogesh Dhami

title: pyrsd: a Python Library for Rainbow Schlieren Deflectometry
quick_description: The Python library behind my thesis's RSD measurements: it turns filter-calibration images into a hue-vs-displacement curve, converts raw color schlieren images into displacement and density-gradient fields, and reconstructs the underlying density field by line integration or a Poisson solver, alongside a small companion image-preprocessing tool.
institution: Personal project, written for my final year thesis, IOE Pulchowk Campus

title: Hypersonics and Advanced Propulsion: Shock Interactions and a Scramjet Intake
quick_description: A self-directed extension of a hypersonics assignment: rhoCentralFoam CFD validating three local-inclination pressure methods on a Mach 6 cylinder, confirming Type I and Type II shock-shock interactions predicted by shock-polar theory, and designing and CFD-validating (inviscid and RANS) a single-ramp scramjet intake at Mach 6.

quick_description: A FOSSEE Fellowship project migrating a published ANSYS Fluent study of a small fixed-wing UAV with an inverted V-tail into OpenFOAM (simpleFoam, Spalart-Allmaras, snappyHexMesh), validating against the original results, then extending the study to blended winglets at 45° and 90° cant angles - finding a 14.95% lift-to-drag improvement at 45° over the baseline.
institution: FOSSEE Fellowship, IIT Bombay, mentored by Asst. Prof. Chandan Bose (University of Birmingham), Asst. Prof. Tushar Chourushi, and CFD Engineer Nikhil Bhamare

title: PIV/POD Analysis of a NACA0015 Airfoil in Reverse Flow
quick_description: A research internship post-processing existing PIV data of a NACA0015 airfoil operating in reverse flow at 12° angle of attack - the regime a retreating rotorcraft blade sees in forward flight. I extracted mean velocity, vorticity, Q-criterion, turbulence intensity, and Reynolds stresses from 500 PIV snapshots, then used Proper Orthogonal Decomposition to pull out the dominant coherent structures in the separated wake and reconstruct it from a reduced set of modes.
institution: Research internship, IIT Kanpur, Experimental Aerodynamics Group, Flow Control Laboratory (Prof. Tufan K. Guha)

title: NIMBUS - Preliminary Design and Flight Dynamics of an Autonomous Agricultural UAV
quick_description: A team conceptual-design project for Nimbus, an autonomous electric crop-duster UAV: sizing and configuration from a matching plot and flight envelope, through a complete flight-dynamics characterization - dynamic stability modes, neutral point, stall/climb/descent performance, and a Cooper–Harper handling-quality assessment.
institution: Aircraft Design and Flight Dynamics courses, IOE Pulchowk Campus, with Amogh Adhikari, Anup Bajgain, and Yogesh Dhami

title: A Manim Animation Explaining PIV
quick_description: A short Manim animation walking through how Particle Image Velocimetry recovers a velocity field from two photographs of a seeded flow. Built as an explainer to guest-lecture sophomores in their Instrumentation Systems course.
institution: Guest lecture, Instrumentation Systems (sophomore course), IOE Pulchowk Campus

title: Schlieren Lab Notebook
quick_description: A running visual notebook of schlieren and shadowgraph experiments - candle plumes, salt-water plumes, electric sparks, glycerin diffusion, and RSD filter-development shots - captured with a Chronus 2.1HD high-speed camera while building the thesis facility.
institution: Flow Visualization Lab, IOE Pulchowk Campus

title: CFD Flow Visualization Reel
quick_description: A growing reel of self-directed CFD runs made mostly out of curiosity: a supersonic bullet, flow past a cylinder from subsonic to hypersonic speed, a Tesla valve, and other subsonic, supersonic, and hypersonic cases, run with the same OpenFOAM/rhoCentralFoam toolchain used for coursework, just pointed at whatever flow looked interesting that week.
